start:
Hi! YouTube download bot

Send a YouTube video link and I will download it for you.

Steps:
1. Send the video link
2. Choose quality or format
3. Receive the file

Use /help for help
help:
Bot help:

1. Send a YouTube video link
2. Choose a quality from the menu
3. The bot downloads the file and sends it to you

/cancel - cancel
cancel: Session cleared. Send the YouTube link again.
language_saved: Your language has been saved. Now your previous request is being processed.
not_a_command: That isn't one of my commands. Send me a YouTube link and I'll download it for you.
metadata_failed: Could not fetch video information. Please try again.
expired_session: Session expired. Send the YouTube link again.
download_started: Downloading... Please wait. The file will be sent soon.
download_failed: ❌ Download failed. Please try again or choose a lower quality.
file_too_large: ❌ File is larger than %s GB. Please choose a lower quality.
upload_failed: ❌ Sending the file failed (%s MB). Please try again.
